Chapter 1121 38: You Are The Great Lord Invincible, What Am I? (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1121 38: You are the Great Lord Invincible, what am I? (Seeking Subscription)

"This power?"

King Chijue's pupils contracted in the distance.

He was still wondering why Lin Yuan didn't join forces with him to fight against King Lingshen, when he witnessed this earth-shaking strike.

"The power of a Galactic Great Lord, comparable to a core royal family grown to the limit? Or is the Galactic Great Lord himself a core royal family grown to the limit?"

King Chijue was filled with uncertainty.

Lin Yuan's strike already proved his strength; even if King Chijue exerted his full power, he couldn't produce such a strike.

Theoretically, a normal Great Lord might match the potential of a core royal family grown to the limit without relying on the bloodline power of the founder.

But that's just theoretical.

Such a Great Lord is even rarer than a Heavenly Venerate.

A core royal family grown to the limit can reach that level with the bloodline power of the founder, so how can a normal Great Lord reach that level?

Therefore,

King Chijue was more inclined to believe Lin Yuan was a core royal family grown to the limit.

Moreover, what Lin Yuan just exhibited was clearly the Fierce Sun world inherent in the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

"A core royal family traveling outside my Fierce Sun Ancient Country?" King Chijue pondered silently.

Fierce Sun Ancient Country has existed for countless ages, and some core royal families who have grown to the limit often venture out to break the shackles that prevent them from stepping into Heavenly Venerate.

They often choose to travel outside, walking through various ancient countries.

The resources and inheritance of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country cannot offer the hope for further advancement, so they borrow the power inheritance of other ancient countries.

Of course, such core royal families are extremely rare, as the number of core royal families is scarce, and even rarer are those who plan to travel various ancient countries after reaching the limit.

"Galaxy."

King Lingshen gazed at Lin Yuan, his mind filled with turbulent thoughts.

He too made the same conjecture as King Chijue, thinking Lin Yuan is a core royal family from Fierce Sun Ancient Country traveling outside.

It happened that he passed by Qingfen Domain, happened to encounter Spirit Might King starting a war, happened to arrive when King Lingshen revealed all his strength, happened...

Many coincidences led to the current scene.

"My luck..." King Lingshen felt somewhat helpless; if any of these coincidences hadn't aligned, this event wouldn't have occurred.

His luck was indeed not good.

"This is troublesome."

King Lingshen looked at Lin Yuan; if the opponent was an extreme core royal family of the same caliber as him, then the plan to invade Qingfen Domain was essentially a failure.

Not only was it a failure, but Purple Dream Domain also had to prevent an invasion from Qingfen Domain. After all, beside Lin Yuan, there was King Chijue on their side.

King Chijue might not have grown to the limit, but he is not someone a peak Great Lord can match. Currently, there is no one strong enough in Purple Dream Domain to hold back King Chijue.

"Is Galaxy really a core royal family from my ancient country? An extreme core royal family?"

In the distance, a group of Great Lords from Qingfen Domain were looking at each other. They could sense the power of Lin Yuan's strike; having reached the level of Great Lord, their vision was sharp, and they immediately made similar conjectures.

After all, only this hypothesis barely made logical sense to explain what was happening before them.

"Qingfen, I didn't expect you to have such fortune..." A peak Great Lord glanced at Lord Qingfen.

As for the master-disciple relationship between Lord Qingfen and Lin Yuan? It was nothing more than this extreme core royal family traveling the world, hiding his identity.

He might even have certain agreements with Lord Qingfen, and is temporarily staying hidden in Qingfen City.

"I..." Lord Qingfen blinked his eyes, inevitably self-doubting.

...

"I have grown to the limit, but have never faced other extreme core royal families from ancient countries."

King Lingshen stared at Lin Yuan, a faint battle intent flickering in his eyes. At this moment, he had forsaken the outcome of the war and only wished to have a proper fight with Lin Yuan, the extreme core royal family from Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Originally, King Lingshen was reluctant to intervene in wars of low intensity; if not for Spirit Might King's involvement, he wouldn't have come.

Now that he has encountered a peer-level opponent, in the face of an impending war defeat, King Lingshen longed to engage Lin Yuan in battle.

The previous battle with King Chijue didn't even count as warm-up; it couldn't be compared with Lin Yuan's suppressive strike using the Fierce Sun Divine Body just now.

"Galaxy, take my slash."

King Lingshen extended his right hand, a silver long knife appeared in his hand, gently slicing toward Lin Yuan.

A subtle, thin blade light flashed and vanished, slicing through the chaotic time and space, and came towards Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan stood unmoving, the Fierce Sun Divine Body operating autonomously; the closer it got to him, the more intense the heat became, forming layers of time and space.

Hiss! Hiss!

The collision between the blade light and the heat spread shockwaves far and wide, sweeping across billions of miles.

This strike from King Lingshen was already at full force; its power was so great that even the shockwaves caused King Chijue, watching the battle nearby, to retreat violently.

"So this is the clash between extreme core royal families?"

King Chijue's expression was serious; he too had sparred with extreme core royal families from Fierce Sun Ancient Country, but those were intramural duels and the opponent would naturally not use full power.

Buzz, buzz, buzz.

The shockwaves continued to spread further, causing the Great Lords watching from afar to tremble in their hearts.

"Is this the strength of extreme core royal families?"

"No wonder they can exchange a few moves with a Heavenly Venerate."

The Great Lords couldn't help but think; among Heavenly Venerates, extreme core royal families are the strongest, which is basic knowledge among various ancient countries.

"So it was blocked?"

King Lingshen, holding the silver long knife, looked at Lin Yuan who remained unmoved, and sliced again.

This knife emitted blade light that split into two, then four, then eight.

In no time, the entire world around King Lingshen was filled with densely packed silver blade light.

"Rise."

Endless silver blade light formed a great array, enveloping Lin Yuan.

"Try something else; these tricks can't really harm me."

Seeing this, Lin Yuan gently flicked his sleeve.

The Fierce Sun Divine Body operated once more, the terrifying world of the Fierce Sun contracted, causing the infinite silver blade light array to quickly disintegrate.

"Hmph."

King Lingshen withdrew his silver long blade, a swirling vortex faintly appeared in his eyes, and a soul-shaking mental impact descended.

"A mental attack technique?"

Lin Yuan immediately detected it, but his mental will was entirely hidden deep within his inner universe.

Currently, Lin Yuan's inner universe was unparalleled in its vastness, the source of the Fierce Sun stationed at the center, with the universe and space-time transformed by the "Infinite Void" surging grandly.

The mental will attack technique that King Lingshen exerted with all his strength was diluted and dissipated the moment it entered the inner universe.

"This guy." King Lingshen frowned, unsure if his mental awareness attack had any effect, let alone shake Lin Yuan's will.

"Since that's the case."

King Lingshen didn't want to continue probing Lin Yuan, whether it was the previous two blade strikes or the mental attack technique, they were just to test Lin Yuan's capabilities.

After all, King Lingshen was facing an extreme core royal clan member of the same level, naturally he had to be cautious.

"Next, is my strongest killing move."

Even before the words left his mouth, King Lingshen's figure dissipated on the spot.

Replaced by endless 'spirits.'

What is spirit?

The spirit is a special kind of energy, existing in all things; the ancestor of the Da Ling Ancient Country is the source of the world's 'spirit.'

The ancestor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country is the eternal Fierce Sun in the sky, high above, worshipped by all living beings.

But the ancestor of the Da Ling Ancient Country is the spirit of all things in the world, the source of all 'spirits,' existing among everything.

"Hahaha, I can feel the extreme abundance of 'spirit' within you, merge with me."

The voice of King Lingshen faintly sounded, at this moment he had transformed into the 'spirit' of the world, even vaguely able to control the 'spirit' within all things.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan's brow slightly furrowed.

He could sense King Lingshen nearby, but couldn't pinpoint his exact location.

At the same time,

Lin Yuan also noticed the qi within his body beginning to agitate.

"Is this the technique of controlling the spirit of all things from the Da Ling Ancient Country?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself, the Da Ling Ancient Country frequently clashed with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, and Lin Yuan naturally had heard of their techniques and abilities.

However, with Lin Yuan's mastery over his physical body, breaking free could be described as perfect, the Great Lord of the Da Ling Ancient Country couldn't control the 'spirit' within him.

But the technique King Lingshen displayed broke the shackles and could influence the spirit within Lin Yuan once more.

Of course, it was only an influence, far from control.

Even so, Lin Yuan felt his internal qi somewhat chaotic, and a frustration began to build in his heart.

"Forget it, I won't play with you anymore."

Lin Yuan wanted to witness the techniques of the core royal family of the Da Ling Ancient Country, but now he lost interest.

Rumble.

Lin Yuan slightly moved his mind, and the Physical Body Divine Ability 'World' unfolded.

The invisible world descended and merged with the Fierce Sun World, for a moment, Lin Yuan's control over the surrounding space-time reached an inconceivable level.

The power of the Divine Ability 'World' is determined by the inner universe.

And the current inner universe of Lin Yuan?

Buzz buzz buzz!

Lin Yuan stood there, seemingly transformed into an eternal Fierce Sun, wherever the sunlight touched became his domain, points of spiritual light seemed forced to emerge, converging again to recreate the image of King Lingshen.

"I?"

King Lingshen looked somewhat bewildered, this move of transforming into 'spirit' was not about having a high offensive power, but it was extremely troublesome, even requiring some effort from a Heavenly Venerate to deal with.

But Lin Yuan?

He directly forced him out of the 'spirit' state?

How is this possible?

"The methods of the core royal clan of Da Ling, are only so-so."

Looking at King Lingshen, Lin Yuan's Physical Body Divine Ability 'World' formed a terrible suppression, leaving King Lingshen unable to resist at all, his physical body, soul, and will began to crumble piece by piece.

"This kind of power?"

"Impossible?!"

King Lingshen found it hard to believe, he struggled with all his might, yet to no avail, he could only watch himself disintegrate piece by piece.

"I have grown to the extreme, an invincible Great Lord, how is this possible, how is this possible?"

King Lingshen stared at Lin Yuan, filled with confusion.

In this source world, among the many ancient countries, those core royal clansmen who have grown to the extreme are considered invincible Great Lords.

"Invincible Great Lord?"

Lin Yuan withdrew the Divine Ability 'World,' his gaze indifferent.

You are an invincible Great Lord.

Then what am I?
